info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Collateral Management API
info.description: The Collateral Management API provides essential functionalities for managing and retrieving information about collateral assets within a banking system. Using this API, developers can access detailed data regarding specific collateral assets, enabling streamlined decision-making and enhanced risk management. Typical consumers include banking and financial institutions that need to monitor and assess collateral in real time. This API plays a critical role in asset administration workflows, ensuring efficient operations and compliance with regulatory requirements.

get.description: Fetch the details of a specific collateral asset administration using its unique identifier. This endpoint allows developers to access essential information related to collateral asset management.

requestBody.description: This request body allows clients to retrieve specific information about the collateral asset identified by RES-100045. It requires a correctly formatted JSON object that complies with the specified schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested collateral asset details.

GetCollateralAssetAdministrationByIdRequ.description: This schema represents the request body for the Operations GET request under the Collateral Asset Administration.
